package.name: bonbon_edge_ai_runtime
package.description:
Cross-capability edge AI orchestration layer for BonBon: a task router that picks the cheapest safe route for every request (rule -> cache -> RAG -> tiny LLM -> ASR/TTS/vision -> degraded fallback -> escalation), a safety separation guard that classifies every proposed action and blocks unsafe direct-control paths, and thin facades over resource guarding, caching, and accelerator selection.
Deliberately NOT a from-scratch reimplementation of everything the Edge AI Runtime brief names: per docs/DUPLICATE_PIPELINE_AUDIT.md, real working implementations already exist for model registry/fallback/runtime-selection (bonbon_ai_model_registry), resource guarding (bonbon_safety.core.resource_monitor, bonbon_perception_efficiency.core.load_shedding_controller, bonbon_llm.core.pi2_llm_guard), degraded mode (bonbon_perception_efficiency.core.degraded_mode_manager), LLM/TTS caching (bonbon_llm.core.response_cache, bonbon_speech_ai.tts_router), and Hailo/CPU/mock vision runtime selection (bonbon_ai_runtime). This package delegates to those rather than duplicating them, and adds only what genuinely didn't exist before: the cross-capability task router, the centralized safety separation classifier, a RAG result cache, and a unified dashboard/metrics view spanning all of the above.
